items.title: Reduce the complexity and cost of real-time processing with queues in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
items.summary: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams now offers queues, a new way to consume the records of an on-demand stream. A queue delivers records one by one, tracks each record's delivery state, redelivers unacknowledged records, sets persistently failing records aside as dead letters, and scales with your backlog instead of your shard count.
items.creator: Dirk Fröhner
